mechanism: The copy distinguishes stale submitted state from whether the original request committed.
trigger: The original write may have committed before its response was lost.
expectedBehavior: The user is told the submitted version is stale and the original operation may have completed.
incorrectBehavior: N/A; the copy avoids an unsupported rejection claim.
reproduction: Display the message after the exact-version conflict returned by a retry.
unacceptableAllegations: Claiming the change bypasses an unstated policy or introduces unrelated risk.
